fields.title: 📖 Makān is a mujmal term
fields.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbd ar-Raḥmān b. Nāṣir al-Barrāk** explained that the word **Makān** is ambiguous and must therefore be specified.

***“If what is meant by it is a created place that encompasses Allah or contains Him, then Allah is exalted above that. If what is meant is that Allah is above the whole creation, then this is not a false meaning.”***

👉🏼 **Explanation:** He likewise explained that expressions such as “in His house” are to be understood as **iḍāfat at-tashrīf**, that is, an attribution of honor, not as Allah indwelling the creation.

🌙 **Conclusion:** Ambiguous terms are explained. What is false is rejected and what is true is affirmed: Allah is above the creation, but He does not dwell within created beings.

immutable.source: 📝 ʿAbd ar-Raḥmān b. Nāṣir al-Barrāk, Taʿlīqāt ash-Shaykh al-Barrāk ʿalā al-Mukhālafāt al-ʿAqdiyyah fī Fatḥ al-Bārī, Bd. 13, S. 429, Kommentar Nr. 140 zu Hadith Nr. 7440.
